notes: Fresh caches and caches of 1..6 shapes in a prebuilt hash tree (also the slot-999 overflow); names cached or new, in upper case, with directories and extensions; shape directory split or not; archive hit or file lookups that succeed in the shape directory, the current directory or not at all. Path, string, tree and hash helpers run as original code; allocation, archive, pool, normalize and file hooks are logging stubs that log strings by content.
